title: Tomb Raider: The Last Revelation
shortDescription: Tomb Raider: The Last Revelation helps define a PC (Windows) action and adventure path in GameAtlas through a frozen catalog method and a direct Wikidata record.
highlights: Maps a direct-reference action and adventure entry into the PC (Windows) catalog.
Uses structured metadata as provenance rather than imported review copy.

signals.label: GameAtlas catalog method
signals.rationale: Listed for the PC (Windows) action and adventure discovery path using a Wikidata-listed catalog relationship; this remains a labeled reference path, not a popularity claim.
